title: Variance
desc: Variance is a mobile app for tracking live poker sessions. It stores everything locally — no account, no cloud, no subscription. The goal is to give players clean stats and honest insight into their game without the bloat of most tracking apps.

title: Reticle
desc: Screenshot tools used to be small, fast, and out of the way. Reticle is a modern return to that: press a global hotkey, drag out a region, mark it up with arrows, shapes, and text, then copy it to the clipboard or save a PNG. Menu-bar only, no account, and nothing ever leaves your Mac.
statusLabel: Coming to the Mac App Store
